summary:
Implementation Plan for Streamlined Page Architecture, Docked Floating Guided Tour Bar, and Bug-Free Live Simulation Synchronization:
1. Re-order sections to keep the client experience crisp and focused: Hero & Persona Spotlight -> Transformed Journey Centerstage (Live Simulation Theater & 3-Layer Solution Mechanics) -> As-Is Bottlenecks as an optional deep dive at the end -> Footer.
2. Re-architect the Guided Tour into a docked floating control bar at the bottom of the viewport with spotlight element ring, reliable auto-scroll, and 1-click live step execution across 6 detailed steps.
3. Fix all tour synchronization bugs between the tour controller and the Centerstage simulation state across all 3 streams (Billing, Collections, Reconciliation).
4. Maintain strict exclusion of all FTE/headcount metrics, using realistic conservative ranges (~10-15% collections uplift, ~7-10% DSO, ~80-85% turnaround gain).
